from pathlib import Path
import json
DATA=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
rows=[]
for p in (DATA/'continuations').glob('CONT-*.json'):
    try:o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    except Exception:continue
    if not isinstance(o,dict):continue
    kind=str(o.get('external_source_kind') or '')
    if 'ASTRA' not in kind:continue
    rows.append((float(o.get('updated_at') or o.get('created_at') or 0),str(o.get('expected_route_task_id') or ''),kind,str(o.get('state') or ''),int(o.get('attempts') or 0),int(o.get('last_acked_attempt') or 0)))
rows.sort(reverse=True)
acked=[r for r in rows[:40] if r[5]>=1]
if acked:
    print('ASTRA_ROUTE_CLASS=RECENT_ACKED route='+acked[0][1]+' kind='+acked[0][2],flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(41)
if rows:
    print('ASTRA_ROUTE_CLASS=NO_ACKED_RECENT count='+str(len(rows))+' newest_route='+rows[0][1]+' newest_kind='+rows[0][2]+' newest_state='+rows[0][3]+' attempts='+str(rows[0][4]),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(42)
print('ASTRA_ROUTE_CLASS=NONE',flush=True)
raise SystemExit(43)
